name: tracker-cli-compatibility
goal: Use the shared Harness CLI and an exec shim to relay Tracker commands with the same bytes, options and exit codes while preserving the existing service.

evidence: Tracker m8fkcj migration plan maps every legacy command. Scope: namespace, exact argv and exit status, stable retained backend and staged shim. Isolated fixtures only. Live system stays on its existing release.
Harness registers the Tracker command family, delegates raw argv to an explicitly selected or retained client, and packages an exec shim. The unit tests exercise launch error and recursion handling.
